title: Unit Event — Dear Me, From Back Then — Episode8 Thanking Them For Their Support

meta.Episode: Episode8 — Thanking Them For Their Support
meta.Event Outline: The time has finally arrived for the first solo show of MORE MORE JUMP! Minori still can't seem to shake her nerves, but is reminded of the time she saw an ASRUN show for the first time after Haruka tells Minori a story about her own past...

rows.Line: Backstage

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We did it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It was really fun... But really nerve-wracking too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can see why since Airi asked you to give that speech, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, that!
You're such a meanie, Airi!
I thought my heart was going to stop!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Remember what I said during the show? A prepared speech would've been so boring.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, I knew that you'd do just fine. Why else would I ask you to do something like that at such a crucial point?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, I didn't expect you to get so tongue-tied in the beginning...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, please don't remind me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But you gave such a wonderful speech, Minori. Not only that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You shined so much as you sang and danced. Actually, this may've been your brightest moment thus far.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I agree. As a fellow idol, I'm kinda jealous, but you were definitely the center of everyone's attention during today's show...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?!
No, stop! There's just no way!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But it's true. If I were in the audience during today's show, I definitely would've been cheering for you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
You reminded me of why I fell in love with idols in the first place...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And the way you performed on stage today showed me that I'll have to do everything I can to keep up with you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: K-Keep up with me...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah. You really carried us today.
I feel like this really was our best performance ever.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, I couldn't be happier with how well our solo show went!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-My mind's having trouble processing all this praise...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But this really did feel like the best show ever! I mean, it felt like we made a real connection with the audience today! Also...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm really glad that I didn't give up... Because being an idol is so much fun now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, as much as I don't want to, we should get changed...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And we shouldn't keep Saito waiting since we still have to clean everything up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, right!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, before we do that, would it be okay if I went to buy some water? I did my best to stay hydrated during the show, but I'm feeling a bit thirsty now...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Then, I'll go buy some!
I'm pretty thirsty too, so I'll go get some for all of us...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, thanks...
W-Wait, don't go through that...!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
Huh?!
Hey, it's Minori!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: No, it's all of MMJ!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
Wait, what?!
Are they gonna do a post-show stream or something?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...? U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Just when I thought you'd grown so much, this happens...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, so many audience members...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This door opens right next to where the main entrance is...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?! It does?!
I-I'm so sorry!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
Minori! Minori!
I really loved that speech you gave today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too!
You made it clear that you're doing your very best, which makes us want to root for you even more.

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I'm tearing up just thinking about it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I'm not sure how else to put it other than... It was really, really amazing.

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: I want more people to know about you, Minori. Lots more...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: About me...?

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
Yeah, absolutely!
Anyone who hears that story's instantly going to become your fan!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: By the way, are recordings of this show going to be available later? I'd like to buy three copies to commemorate the occasion and let people know that MMJ is here to stay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, um, so...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry, we don't have any plans for that.

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
What?! Why not?!
That means we're the only ones who are gonna know about what happened today...!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: Please consider recording your next show! Especially since this one made us all want to keep supporting MMJ moving forward!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
Oh, how about a tour?!
I'd definitely go to every show!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: Yeah, you should perform all over the country! As much as I want to tell my friends how amazing today was, words just can't do this show justice... Please, someday!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-W-Wah...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
U-Uhh... Thank you all very much!
We haven't considered any of those options, but we really appreciate all your suggestions...

rows.Speaker: Little Girl
rows.Line: Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Little Girl
rows.Line:
So, um...!
I've been watching lots and lots of your videos at home... And I loved how sparkly you were today!

rows.Speaker: Little Girl
rows.Line:
You were really, really pretty.
That's why I...

rows.Speaker: Little Girl
rows.Line:
I want to become an idol just like you!
So, let's sing together someday!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course! I'll be waiting!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sorry, everyone...
But we really need to clean up before we leave.

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: What?! You're helping clean too?!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: I'm so glad I got to see you all after the show! I'm gonna keep rooting for all of you, so please put on another one of these shows!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
I can't wait for your next stream!
If you girls do another long stream like for your training camp, I'll take work off to watch it!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: You're definitely going places, and I'm really looking forward to that happening!

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't think any of us can wait for that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much...!
Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ahh, that felt so nice!
There's nothing better than taking a bath right after a show.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
My chest feels so warm...
I don't think it's because of the bath either...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean...

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't think any of us can wait for that!

rows.Speaker: Little Girl
rows.Line:
I want to become an idol just like you!
So, let's sing together someday!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Today's show was so much fun.
I hope everyone in the audience felt the same way...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget...
I should see if anyone's said anything about it online!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Let's see... I'll search for...
“MMJ Solo Show”...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa!
I got a ton of results!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<How do I even put it into words? It was amazing. Period.>
<They blew my mind and it felt awesome.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <I've been following MMJ since they first formed, but they've grown so much as a group. I'm so glad I supported them all this time.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line: <Today's show united all of us MMJ fans together. They forever have my support.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank goodness.
It sounds like they really enjoyed everything.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But seeing all these comments...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I really hope MMJ's fan base keeps growing.>
<They should do more stuff than just streams.>
<Yeah. I know it won't be easy, but they need to find a way to appear on TV.>

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<They're such an amazing group. I want more people to know about them.>
<They just gotta keep advertising themselves. That should get the ball rolling in terms of their popularity.>
<I know it's easier said than done, but they should do a show at the Dome.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They all have such high hopes for us...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This was our very first solo show and we're really still just getting on our feet... But they want us to become more popular.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: They see what we do and dream about us achieving more...

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I'm tearing up just thinking about it...

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I'm not sure how else to put it other than... It was really, really amazing.

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: I want more people to know about you, Minori. Lots more...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Some people were shedding tears... For me...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That really left me speechless...
I still have a lot to work on as an idol, but that felt like proof that I was able to connect with them...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's exactly what I felt when I went to that ASRUN show... I finally sort of feel like an idol who can bring everyone together by responding to their cheering...

rows.Speaker: Fans
rows.Line: I want more people to know about you, Minori. Lots more...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Until now, all I could do was hope that I'd be able to spread hope to people who watch our stream and come to our events.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(But I...
If possible, I want to try reaching more people. And our fans genuinely want me to do that...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know it won't be easy...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But I want to do more and more...
I want to do more events, go on tour, appear on TV... With everyone, as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And then, to all of those who helped me become an idol...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll give back by spreading hope to every single one of them...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
As long as I remain an idol...
I'm never gonna stop!
